items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: No I played with Benny too, that's my boy.

ctx.x: You know we were talking to Benny Turner and he told us to play with Williamson too and his piano when he was in the Navy.
No I played with Benny too, that's my boy. We used to work for the, across the river.
When did you work with them?
